full_prompt_en: A square, cinematic fantasy portrait shows a blue-skinned man from the upper chest upward against a dark, softly blurred background. His face occupies most of the center and right of the frame, with a lifted mass of brown hair touching the upper edge and a high burgundy collar framing his neck below. The background is nearly black; on the left, a few indistinct warm vertical shapes remain far behind him, giving a slight sense of depth without forming a readable setting. Small round glasses with thin gold-toned rims sit across the middle of his face. Their lenses are deep amber and catch reddish reflections, allowing only a subdued view of his eyes. Fine copper-colored temples angle outward toward his ears. The skin has a mottled cobalt and teal surface, with subtle raised texture and narrow etched marks along his cheek and forehead. A short, closely trimmed beard follows the jaw and mouth, where the expression remains firm and quiet. His coat has a thick, rough burgundy surface, worn highlights along its upright collar, and bands of small metallic plates over the shoulder at the lower left. A patterned scarf and a short necklace of warm brown beads appear in the narrow gap above the coat. The crop presses closely around the head and shoulders, turning the glasses, textured skin, and weathered fabric into the main visual evidence of the character. Directional warm light reaches the upper left of the hair, the rims of the glasses, and the coat edge; cooler light picks out the blue face while the far side falls into soft shadow. The overall composition sets vivid blue and burgundy against deep black, producing a tactile, dramatic portrait with a restrained expression.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形的电影感奇幻肖像，在深色、柔焦的背景前呈现一位胸部以上入画的蓝色皮肤男子。他的面孔占据画面中部和右侧大部分区域，一团向上蓬起的棕发触及上边缘，下面高立的酒红衣领围住颈部。背景近乎黑色；左边几道模糊的暖色竖形远在人物后方，只提供一点纵深感，并未形成可辨认的具体场所。细金色边框的小圆眼镜横在面部中央，深琥珀色镜片带红色反光，眼睛只能隐约看见。细铜色镜腿向两侧耳朵伸去。皮肤表面由斑驳的钴蓝和青蓝组成，带微微凸起的肌理，面颊和前额有狭细的刻痕。短而贴面的胡须沿着下颌和嘴部生长，神情坚定而安静。他的外套有厚重粗糙的酒红表面，立领边缘呈磨旧的亮部，左下角肩部覆盖着一排排小金属片。有花纹的围巾和一串暖棕色短珠链出现在外套上方的窄缝中。紧密的裁切贴着头肩，使眼镜、带肌理的皮肤和旧化布料成为人物的主要视觉依据。暖色定向光照到左上方的头发、镜框和外套边缘；较冷的光挑出蓝色面部，较远一侧则落入柔和阴影。整体构图让鲜明的蓝色与酒红色对照深黑，形成触感强烈、戏剧性足而神情克制的肖像。
style_prompt_en: The image has a cinematic, highly tactile finish built from close framing, shallow focus, and sharply separated warm and cool color. Dense dark areas recede behind a narrow band of luminous, textured form. Blue and teal modeling carries fine pores, scuffs, and engraved-looking lines; adjacent burgundy surfaces appear coarse and worn, with small reflective accents catching the light. Edges at the focal plane are crisp, then fall quickly into velvety blur and near-black negative space. Warm amber glints punctuate the cool dominant color without flattening its volume. Directional light skims raised surfaces and leaves soft, deep shadows in the recesses, giving the composition a sculptural weight. The overall treatment is dramatic but controlled, joining fantasy color with convincing material detail.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有电影般且触感强烈的完成面，由近距离取景、浅景深和清楚分离的冷暖色构成。浓重暗部退到一条发亮、有肌理的形体带后面。蓝色与青蓝塑形中可见细微孔隙、擦痕和近似刻出的线纹；相邻酒红表面则粗糙而旧化，少量反光强调抓住光线。焦点平面的边缘清晰，随后迅速落入天鹅绒般的虚化与近黑色留白。琥珀色暖光点穿插在冷色主调里，却不压平其体积。定向光掠过凸起表面，让凹处保有柔和而深沉的阴影，使构图具有雕塑般的重量。整体处理戏剧性强却有节制，将奇幻色彩与可信的材料细节结合。
theme_en: A blue-skinned man in round amber glasses and a weathered burgundy coat
theme_zh: 一位蓝色皮肤的男子戴琥珀色圆眼镜，穿旧化酒红外套
name: James Gunn
